title: Uniform closed-ball bound gives μ(B) ≤ c·μH[n](B) (covering argument)
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, let μ be a Borel measure on ℝ^N, let B ⊆ ℝ^N be an arbitrary set, and let c ∈ (0, ∞) and δ > 0. Suppose μ(B̄_ρ(x)) ≤ c·ρⁿ for every x ∈ B and every real ρ with 0 < ρ < δ. Then μ(B) ≤ c·μH[n](B). Here μH[n] is Mathlib's unnormalized n-dimensional Hausdorff measure, with covering cost (diam C)ⁿ and t⁰ = 1 also for t = 0. Both sides are outer-measure values in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (B : Set (Rn N)) (c : ℝ≥0∞) (δ : ℝ), c ≠ 0 → c ≠ ∞ → 0 < δ → (∀ x ∈ B, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < δ → μ (Metric.closedBall x ρ) ≤ c * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) → μ B ≤ c * μH[(n : ℝ)] B
